ANNEX 1 (Related to Article 5(1))
Standards for Assignment of Librarians and Professional Staff

Basis for calculation | Minimum number of personnel to be assigned
--- | ---
Where the number of students is 1,000 or more AND the library collection contains 50,000 items or more | 1. Junior colleges: at least 2 librarians; 2. Universities other than junior colleges: at least 3 librarians
Where the number of students is less than 1,000 OR the library collection contains fewer than 50,000 items | 1. Junior colleges: at least 1 librarian; 2. Universities other than junior colleges: at least 2 librarians

Notes:
1. "Number of students" means the total of enrolled undergraduate and graduate students. "Number of items in the library collection" means the total number of registered library materials consisting of printed materials, manuscript materials, audiovisual materials, microform materials and electronic materials (limited to electronic books) at the university or college library concerned.
2. "Junior college" means a school under Article 2, subparagraph 4, of the Higher Education Act.
3. Standards for assignment of professional staff shall be determined in consideration of the number of students, the size of the library collection and other relevant circumstances, to the extent that the teaching and learning of students and faculty members are not impeded.
